description: Read only. How good the business's leads are, in plain words, grouped by campaign, ad, form, source, organic vs from an ad, or (for the owner, an admin or a manager) a qualifying answer on the form: how many came, how many the owner marked and how many of those were good or became customers, over the last 90 days. Useful for 'which campaign brings good leads?', 'is the form bringing junk?', before suggesting where to move money.

account.description: An ad account's name or id, to see one account only; omit for all of them.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.
